name: Blacks Marrying Whites
overview: Scripture teaches that God shows no partiality among people, as Peter declares that God is no respecter of persons (Acts 10:34). In Christ, distinctions such as ethnicity, social status, and gender are transcended, uniting all believers as one (Galatians 3:28). While the Bible emphasizes the necessity of blood for forgiveness and cleansing (Hebrews 9:22), the unity in Christ affirms that racial differences do not hinder the spiritual bond between believers, including in the context of marriage.
